findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "docs_search" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Search official DS Platform specifications, guides, wiki pages, contracts, and examples by keyword, category, and spec version (DS2-SPEC-V2.0 default or DS2-SPE…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "dsdx.scene.build_show_demo" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Generate a self-contained 3D Build Show & integrated 3D-AAS offline viewer HTML resource URI from an official built-in public example (no customer source uploaded). Supports id/exampleId, lang/language ('ko'|'en'), aspectPreset ('landscape-16x9'|'shorts-9x16'|'square-1x1'), cleanShortsMode, subPartA" → after: "Generate a self-contained 3D Build Show & integrated 3D-AAS offline viewer HTML resource URI from an official built-in public example (no customer source uploaded). Supports id/exampleId (default: 'status-indicator-cell-v2'; unknown id falls back to the default official demo with fallback=true), lan"

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
